title: 第21章 火力覆盖大当家死第22章 哇金色传说
slug: 全民高塔开局一个神话天赋
lines: “古瓦！”
两个山贼双眸猩红，疯狂厮打，全身都是血液。
他们放弃了砍刀和弓箭，拳拳到肉，多重的伤势都不顾，一直到被打死为止。
甚至有一个山贼已经在混战中被打断了腿，依旧在地上爬行，拖着长长的血迹试图继续加入混战。
哒哒——
脚步声响起，断腿山贼转头看去，注意到了接近过来的吴语。
他怪叫一声，伸出血腥的手臂试图抓住吴语。
手臂上还残留有其他山贼的血肉和脏器碎片，也有一条深可见骨的伤口。
噗！
一把砍刀呼啸斩下，山贼身首分离，躯体抽搐几下便不动了。
吴语双手握住砍刀，看着刀身上的丝丝黑气，心中惊奇。
“之前用刀砍杀第一个山贼的时候，刀刃都卷了才砍死。”
“现在两次功法入门的强化，再加上《虎啸八斩刀》的这一招【虎啸刀】，威力竟然这么惊人！”
“【虎啸刀】虽然只有一招，但附带气血，会有摄人心魄的超凡威能。”
“第一刀消耗极少，但出刀越多，气血消耗越多，对应的刀法威力也越强大。”
回忆了一下《虎啸八斩刀》的内容，吴语身形一动，挥舞砍刀朝着其余山贼砍去。
还活着的山贼个个带伤，再加上还在疯狂厮打，所以也只有少数山贼会攻击吴语，没啥威胁。
杀了几个之后，吴语下手逐渐熟稔，也就不需要开启【乾坤】状态和动用刀法了，刀刀致命。
不久后，吴语将砍刀丢下，坐在一具山贼的尸体上喘气休息。
现实终归不是游戏，即便是变得更加壮实了，一连砍杀上百个山贼依旧让他有些力竭。
但考虑到“山贼大当家”还在，他也不敢浪费时间。
“手都得抽筋。”
吴语眉头微皱，甩了甩手臂。
看向物品栏，他取出了一壶“上品灵酒”。
上品灵酒在恢复气血上不如精致食物，但吴语为了储备火力这一天不断在吃，肚子都快炸了。
哪怕食物味道再好，吴语此刻也毫无食欲。
更别说在一堆尸体中间......
他草草地喝了几口，感觉身体恢复了一些力气后便开始收拾地上的卡片。
【气血丹】，【兽肉】，【令人不适的肉块】，【劣质砍刀】，【银两】......
大量卡片收入物品栏，堆积在同一个格子里。
content_en:
"Guwa!"
The two bandits had scarlet eyes and were fighting wildly, with blood all over their bodies.
They gave up machetes and bows and arrows, punched to the flesh, and ignored multiple injuries until they were beaten to death.
There was even a bandit whose leg had been broken in the melee. He was still crawling on the ground, dragging a long trail of blood and trying to continue joining the melee.
Ta da——
The sound of footsteps sounded, and the bandit with a broken leg turned his head and noticed Wu Yu approaching.
He screamed strangely and stretched out his bloody arms to try to catch Wu Yu.
There were still pieces of flesh, blood and organ fragments from other bandits on the arm, and there was also a wound deep enough to show the bone.
puff!
A machete whizzed down, and the bandit's head was separated. His body twitched a few times and then stopped moving.
Wu Yu held the machete with both hands and looked at the traces of black energy on the blade, feeling surprised.
"When I used a knife to kill the first bandit, the blade curled up before I killed him."
"Now that the two introductory exercises have been strengthened, coupled with this move [Tiger Roaring Sword] of the "Tiger Roaring Eight Swords", the power is so amazing!"
"[Tiger Roaring Sword] only has one move, but with the energy and blood attached to it, it will have breath-taking and extraordinary power."
"The first sword consumes very little, but the more swords are fired, the more energy and blood are consumed, and the corresponding sword technique becomes more powerful."
After recalling the contents of "The Roaring Tiger and the Eight Cutting Swords", Wu Yu moved and swung the machete towards the other bandits.
The bandits who were still alive were all injured, and they were still fighting wildly, so only a few bandits would attack Wu Yu, so there was no threat.
After killing a few, Wu Yu gradually became familiar with his moves, and there was no need to activate the [Qiankun] state and use sword skills. The sword was deadly.
...
Soon after, Wu Yu dropped the machete and sat on the corpse of a bandit to catch his breath.
Reality is not a game after all. Even though he has become stronger, killing hundreds of bandits in a row still makes him exhausted.
But considering that the "bandit master" is still there, he doesn't dare to waste time.
"My hands are cramping."
Wu Yu frowned slightly and shook his arm.
Looking at the inventory, he took out a pot of "Fine Spiritual Wine".
High-grade spiritual wine is not as good as exquisite food in restoring energy and blood, but Wu Yu kept eating all day in order to reserve firepower, and his stomach was about to explode.
No matter how good the food tastes, Wu Yu has no appetite at the moment.
Not to mention among a pile of corpses...
"Gudu——!"
He drank a few sips hastily, and after feeling that his body had regained some strength, he began to collect the cards on the ground.
[Qi and Blood Pill], [Animal Meat], [Uncomfortable Meat], [Inferior Machete], [Silver Liang]...
A large number of cards are collected into the inventory and piled up in the same grid.
